summary: National HealthCare Corporation filed an 8-K on May 7, 2026, disclosing a press release announcing a 4.7% increase in its quarterly common dividend to $0.67 per share, payable on July 31, 2026 to shareholders of record June 30, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special-situations event. It is purely an ordinary capital return announcement with no structural or deal-related implications. No risk-arb angle or regulatory clock applies.
